title: Waiting for the Morning Glories

placements.sceneDescription: Afternoon on a modest Japanese apartment balcony: Kenta has hurried outside and leans toward the potted morning glory, studying its five closed buds, whose tips look slightly wilted. Keep the buds closed and show no open flowers.
Existing image: Kenta and his grandmother notice a tiny blue tip on the largest closed bud at dusk.

Cool predawn on the same Japanese apartment balcony: Kenta and his grandmother sit by the pot with two simple glasses of barley tea as exactly three blue morning-glory flowers slowly open. Pale dawn light begins to soften the sky.
